declaredBounds: The `rollback:"failed"` shape is now KEPT by the same evidence rule, but its arm (A12c) is driven by REMOVING the record before the rollback's re-read; the OTHER failed sub-shape (atomicWriteText throwing while the record still exists) is not separately injected.

The `rebind` verb writes the TEAM record FILE (the plane exposes no seat-rebind verb); it uses the same snapshot → compare → temp+rename CAS and the same plane read-back as the bind, so the same cross-process residual between compare and rename remains DECLARED (docs §F2), not closed.

`rebind` is a parameter of `cellwork_dispatch`, which requires the team plane's `mpdTeamActions` service; in this bundle `mpdTeams` (the record) and `mpdTeamActions` are served by the SAME team-core row, so a composition that owns a team record also owns the repair verb.
A `rebind` re-points identity and mirrors the CELL row; it does NOT clear a fence (the unfence lever owns `fenced`/`fencedReason`), so the repair sentence names BOTH verbs in one call.

The re-entry guard requires the registry to PROVE liveness. On a composition whose adapter exposes no `liveAgentExact` (or whose lookup throws) the guard is inert and the old path runs; that is deliberate (an unproven seat is never a reason to skip), and A16 exercises only the proven-live path.
The guard only fires when the CELL row records a NON-EMPTY session different from the live TEAM handle; a cell row whose `sessionId` is empty keeps the pre-fix behaviour by design.
